sources: directory (sequence_id parsed from the VisDrone filename)
GT-derived (counts, sizes, dominant class, per-class counts)
domain knowledge (gt_border_fraction as a truncation proxy; boxes_per_megapixel; letterbox_scale; mean_box_side_model_px = object size at model resolution)
nan_policy: explicit types on all concepts; None for undefined size stats and dominant_class on images without boxes (correct); per-class counts are real zeros
domain_fields: gt_border_fraction (truncation proxy from box geometry), boxes_per_megapixel (density), mean_box_side_model_px (size the detector actually sees after letterboxing)
noise: mean_brightness generic; width/height legitimately vary across VisDrone images
friction: leap projects create overwrote leap.yaml with a blank template (rewrote by hand); push queued behind a foreign project's Evaluate on the shared cluster
